sample_unit: patients (MIMIC-IV admissions cohort; test split n=9,857)

links.outcome: Calibration of readmission risk probabilities from A3 model
links.effect: Predicted probabilities over-confident in higher-risk bins; A3 calibration slope 0.741; pre-deployment recalibration needed.
links.quote: Because predicted probabilities are over-confident in higher-risk bins (A3 calibration slope 0.741), pre-deployment recalibration is a prerequisite for any probability-based clinical use.

links.outcome: Objective signal loss between pipeline stages with signal-integrity audit and regeneration
links.effect: Doc-level objective loss of 15.55% (N=4,000) reduced to 8.48% by offline hybrid regeneration without extra LLM calls.
links.quote: a signal-integrity audit (N=4,000) finds 15.55% doc-level objective loss, reduced to 8.48% by offline hybrid regeneration without extra LLM calls.

unlisted_practices: Local-first on-device small-model deployment to avoid cloud data transfer
Prompt KV-cache reuse for bit-exact, faster inference
Schema-guided structured extraction with format-validity checks (KVT4 output contract)

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a local text-structuring pipeline incorporating a signal-integrity gate and offline hybrid regeneration to reduce silent objective signal loss and maintain contract stability for clinical risk prediction.
